name: Ju Mira
source:
A former journalist who visited the snack shop as an influencer.
For some reason, she offers a business opportunity to the cook.
There seems to be a story behind the difference between her energetic character in the video 
and her actual personality.

[From [url=https://cfk.kr/miracle/en.php]Official English site[/url]]
